rule: Delivery attributes for the roadmap (S6 CIO challenge Q7 and D4; scorecard area 13(c)). LTM heuristic, not a market fact: for review by sovereignty-compliance-lead and approval by the product owner. Effort is the work needed, as a band; duration is the typical elapsed time for one organisation to put the control in place, set by the type of work and never by severity. Severity sets when the work starts; a dependent action starts only once its prerequisite is expected to reach its milestone (the end of the prerequisite's duration); decisions and scope confirmations start at once. 'movedDuration' applies to data location when the placement matrix says the data needs a sovereign offering (a migration, not a reconfiguration).

effortBands.XL: A programme: several teams, more than nine FTE-months
